system.name: GenAL
system.one_liner: Two LLM agents, a global one that updates learner profiles and reflects and a local one that recommends exercises with educational tools, for adaptive learning.

content.variant_note: two role-named agents in stacked tinted regions, with the learner outside on the left and a closed loop of answers, recommendations, feedback and reflection
content.argues: A global agent that reflects on the learner's history and a local agent that picks the next exercise with teaching tools cooperate in one loop with the learner.
content.subject: Learner, Global Thinking Agent (log memory, reflector) and Local Teaching Agent (answer, recommender) exchanging answers, feedback, reflections, exercises.

lessons.what_to_learn: Give each agent its own tinted region titled by role, put the user outside in a white column, and close the loop with one thick return arrow; a framed legend strip then explains every arrow type and tile in one line.
lessons.suits: LLM systems with two or three cooperating agents and a user, where a few typed flows (forward, backward, tool use) must be told apart.

evidence: Global Thinking Agent, which aims to update profiles and recommended strategies from learners’ history records.
Additionally, we asked for explanations (Ft+1) and predictions of the learner’s response (At+1).
the Global Thinking Agent (GTA) and the Local Teaching Agent (LTA)

summary: GenAL recommends learning paths with two cooperating LLM agents instead of indexed items: a Global Thinking Agent that keeps the learner's log, reflects on outcomes and updates profiles, and a Local Teaching Agent that picks the next exercise using teaching tools. The figure draws the agents as two stacked tinted regions, green on top and blue below, each holding tool, memory and LLM boxes, with a cartoon learner outside on the left. Thick black arrows carry answers, recommendations and explanations round the loop; red dashed arrows carry feedback and reflection; mint double arrows mark tool use. A legend strip names the arrows and the Mem and frozen-LLM tiles; answer cards with ticks and a cross show the log.
summary_zh: GenAL 的总览图：绿色的全局思考智能体与蓝色的局部教学智能体上下叠放，内部是工具、记忆和冻结 LLM 方块，学习者在左侧；黑色实线、红色虚线和青绿色双向箭头分别表示正向流、反馈与反思、工具调用，底部图例说明各种箭头和图块。
notes: Kind kept as the prior (actor-interaction, multi-agent-organization); the loop also resembles a closed-loop pipeline but the agents are the protagonists. The icons are vector paths; the five small PNGs in the file are equal-height strips (probably formula text lines). 'Feedback' is read as feedback from the answer to the log (red arrow from the Answer box with faces); the paper text given does not describe it.
